d:
Sometimes the hardest thing is not losing someone.
It’s accepting that they have already moved on.
“Barsaat” is a story of a girl who loved with all her heart but was left behind by the person she trusted the most. While he moved on, she remained stuck between memories, questions and hope.
She keeps saying:
“Tne meri yaad ave gi”
Not because she wants revenge.
Not because she hates him.
But because she believes nobody will ever love him the way she did.
